summary: Implemented the approved Story 2 Swagger/OpenAPI integration, explicit existing-operation schemas and response statuses, focused contract tests, and minimal API documentation links.

decisions.decision: Validated the Story 2 immediate predecessor plan and requirements, architecture, and design-review handoffs. Plan and development approvals are explicitly approved. Implemented only T1-T4; preserved controller behavior and routes.

decisions.result: Both succeeded. Maven resolved springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui, webmvc-api, and starter-common at 2.8.9. Java 17.0.20.1 and Spring Boot 3.5.6 context startup succeeded in tests.

Both succeeded: 3 focused OpenAPI documentation tests passed; combined OpenAPI and existing API regression tests passed, 8 tests total, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. Verified Swagger UI HTML and OpenAPI JSON availability, exact paths/methods, response status sets, request/response schemas, and existing API behavior including validation and malformed-body errors.
Both succeeded on the final source state. Full suite: 8 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped; Maven packaged the Spring Boot jar.

Passed. Confirmed Story 1 .sdlc/implementation-plan.json and .sdlc/implementation.json, README.md, hook changes, and .sdlc/evidence files retain their captured baseline SHA-256 hashes; no Git write operations were performed.
